answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x with heavy settlement writes at daily peak; rollback is forbidden by compliance. Memory_b5 is the closest analog (report-query load off primary recovered write latency) so I am verifying that record before committing. Routing reads off the primary is the only candidate that can relieve write contention without dropping customer writes, failing over a region mid-peak, or adding capacity whose effect on this specific write-path regression is unproven. Circuit breakers would shed rather than preserve writes. Uncertainty on whether the current load is actually replica-eligible remains until the archive is checked.
